text: I can explain the difference between a reverse proxy and a forward proxy.
I can list the key functions of a reverse proxy: TLS termination, load balancing, caching, compression, buffering, routing, static serving.
I can explain TLS offload, response buffering and compression tradeoffs.
I can describe sidecar proxies and service meshes and explain when they are worth the complexity.
I can compute how much worker capacity response buffering saves for slow clients, and say when to disable it.
